verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says what happens when a plan's monthly credit or request quota is exceeded, whether overage billing or a hard cutoff. The only nearby items are per-minute rate-limit headers and a timeout mode that fails without a charge. Both are adjacent controls, not a documented monthly-quota overage policy.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether exceeding my plan's monthly credit or request quota triggers overage charges or a hard cutoff
